name: WARDEN 💀 Survival Escape
desc:
How many Trials can you survive while the Corrupted hunts you? Something bad happened to Sonaria, so you must go into the unknown and find out! 

Start as Mylo, team up and explore strange places full of monsters, puzzles, bosses, and hidden secrets.

Based on the Creatures of Sonaria universe

Up to 8 player co-op to maximize your chances of getting as far as you can! Leaderboards reset monthly.

🗺️ Explore new places & go deeper every run
🏃 Run, hide & finish tasks while monsters hunt you
👹 Escape scary bosses
🧩 Solve puzzles & find secrets
🧬 Discover and unlock new Delvers!
🃏 Collect cards & plushies to grow stronger
🤝 Win with friends and get rewards!

🌟 Favorite the game and join Sonar Studios for exclusive in-game rewards!

Tags: Thriller, Monster, Kaiju, Animals, Fantasy Horror, PvE, Multiplayer, Mystery, Exploration, Puzzle
